title: Emir Sensini - Topic
description:
Emir Sensini nació un 6 de Abril en la ciudad de Rosario (Argentina) 
Apasionado por la música y el canto, compone sus primeras canciones.
-2002 lanzaba su primera producción titulada "Déjate Llevar" 
-2005 logró alcanzar la meta de grabar un disco maravilloso, titulado “Valórate”, en el cual se refleja gran parte de su testimonio personal y vivencias.
-2011 bajo el sello discográfico “Reyvol Records” Emir graba su tercer álbum, “Hoy me rindo a ti”, un excelente disco de alabanza y adoración que impactó en gran manera, con canciones como “Esta nación hoy vuelve a Ti” y “Eres digno de adorar”
 
Emir ha servido por más de 10 años en su iglesia local en Rosario, Argentina como director de alabanza, predicador, y junto a su esposa Soledad como líderes de jóvenes y adolescentes. 
 
-2015 graba su primer álbum de alabanza y adoración EN VIVO, en “El Redil de Cristo”, iglesia que lo vio nacer como adorador. Nuevamente de la mano de Emmanuel Espinosa como productor. En esta oportunidad Emir y su esposa tuvieron la oportunidad de componer juntos varias de las canciones. 
-2016 “Deseo tu gloria” fue nominado para un Latin Grammy en la terna “mejor álbum de música cristiana”. 
Hoy en día podemos decir que para la gloria de Dios millones de personas están adorando y conectándose con el corazón del padre a través de cada adoración. 
“Deseo tu gloria” es más que un disco, es un puente que nos conduce a los brazos de Dios, para manifestarnos como un reflejo suyo aquí en la tierra.

title: Pedro Paulo & Alex - Topic
description:
Pedro Paulo & Alex (PPA) estão entre os nomes mais autênticos e versáteis da música brasileira. Misturando sertanejo, country, reggaeton e ritmos latinos, a dupla transformou a energia das repúblicas universitárias em um fenômeno nacional, conquistando públicos de diferentes gerações em todo o país.

Formada em 2012, a dupla reúne Pedro Paulo (José Aparecido Amorim Junior), natural de Umuarama (PR), e Alex Stella, nascido em Santo André (SP) e criado em Maringá (PR). Pedro Paulo traz influências do rock e do country, além de atuar como multi-instrumentista e compositor. Já Alex agrega referências do sertanejo raiz e da música latina, formando a identidade sonora que se tornou marca registrada do PPA.

Ao longo da carreira, gravaram nove DVDs e lançaram projetos marcantes como Sucesso nas Repúblicas, 10 Anos PPA e PPA Acústico Sem Limites.

Em 2025, viveram uma de suas fases mais importantes. O sucesso de Carmed Chocolate, parceria com Diego & Victor Hugo, ultrapassou 16 milhões de visualizações no YouTube e 21 milhões de streams no Spotify. Na sequência, o projeto PPA no Paredão Vol. 2 ganhou destaque com Que Delícia, feat com Country Beat, que alcançou o Top 11 do Spotify Brasil.

Outro marco foi a parceria com a label Farra dos Brabu e a dupla Us Agroboy, que resultou em três faixas inéditas de grande repercussão.

Com milhões de plays, agenda intensa de shows e uma base fiel de fãs, consolidando-se como uma das principais forças do sertanejo.

title: Los Rieleros Del Norte - Topic
description: Since the ’80s, Los Rieleros del Norte have been one of the top bands in traditional Mexican music. All over Mexico and the southwestern United States, norteño music is extremely popular, and those places are where Los Rieleros del Norte have their largest fan base.  Los Rieleros recorded their first album in 1982 and went on to build a sizable catalog in the ’80s and ’90s; after extensively recording for Joey International, they went to Fonovisa. Along the way, they have had countless hits; “Amor Prohibido,” “No le Digas a Nadie,” “En la Puerta de Esa Casa,” “Una Aventura,” “Me Lo Contaron Ayer,” and “Copa Sin Vino” are among the many Rieleros singles that were played extensively on Mexican radio. One of their biggest hits was 1999′s “Te Quiero Mucho,” which reached number one on Billboard’s Hot Latin Tracks chart.  Members of the band have included Daniel Esquivel (accordion, vocals), Alfredo Esquivel (drums), Angel Esquivel (Bass) , Jose Luis Esquivel (Bajo) ,  Daniel Esquivel Jr.(Accordion)  and Pemo Gonzalez (Sax). Between 2003 and 2015, they placed no less than five albums in the Top 200, and ten more on Top Latin and Mexican Regional charts including Abriendo Caminos, Y Que el Mundo Ruede , En Vivo Para Ti, and 2015′s Corridos y Canciones de Mi Tierra. Dozens of singles have also placed on airplay, streaming, and sales charts. They were nominated for Latin Grammy Awards three times.

title: Wilmer Cartagena
description:
Wilmer Cartagena es un afrodescendiente peruano, nacido en 1975 en el Callao (Lima-Perú). Fue mánager y administrador por mas de una década de su hermano Antonio Cartagena desempeñándose dentro de la banda también como corista y bailarín. Se graduó como ingeniero en computación y sistemas para aumentar sus conocimientos como mánager en su rubro.
En el 2006 le proponen el relanzamiento de las canciones «Si Esto No es Amor» y «Un Amor Como el Tuyo», siendo el disco del año «Un Amor Como el Tuyo». Realizando muchas giras por el mundo a través del tiempo.
La canción con más éxito y en la que se dio a relucir como un gran cantante fue "Infidelidad", la cual llegó a ser disco del año 2017 – 2018 en Perú.
Hoy en día en su carrera como solista Wilmer cartagena se encuentra vigente dando su arte y pasión a través de cada canción con su slogan: AZOTAMEEEEEEE...JA. JUUUAAA...

description:
Kabusa Oriental Choir is a Choir from Nigeria that is known for creating choir versions of popular songs. 

The Choir was created by Austin Chinemezu Nwamara, the Director, on the 11th of March 2019 when he published their first song which was a choral mashup cover of 'Yeba' and 'Baba'; it went viral and launched the choir into limelight. 

Over the years, Kabusa Oriental Choir has evolved from just creating choir covers of popular songs to featuring in major mainstream songs like 'Pray' by BNXN FKA BUJU, 'As always' by Skales, 'Giving dem' by Yung Willis and Timaya, 'My G' by Kizz Daniel, 'That Guy' by Zlatan Ibile, ' Rise up' by DJ Neptune ft. Laycon, Ladipoe, Waje. 

On February 2020, Kabusa Oriental Choir released a song for Valentine's Day titled 'Valentine is Coming' which Launched the choir into the international scene; especially in the United Kingdom where it was featured on BBC 1XTRA RADIO in 2020 during the Valentine week. It has become a ritual to release new verses to the song every year.

The Choir has gone on to create more covers like 'Soso' which blew up on TikTok and exceeded one million streams on Spotify and 'Soweto' which caught the attention of Swae Lee 

The choir was honoured with the award for Best in Music Comedy in the 2nd edition of Humour Award.

Current stats shows that the choir has over a 100k monthly listeners exceeding one million streams

title: Philipp Poisel
description:
Philipp Poisel ist einer der einflussreichsten Songwriter der deutschen Musik. Seit seinem Debüt „Wo fängt dein Himmel an?“ (2008) prägt er mit seiner unverwechselbaren Mischung aus Poesie, Emotionalität und Tiefe die deutsche Popkultur. Er hat es geschafft, leise Töne massentauglich zu machen. Seine Alben erreichten Gold- und Platin-Status, seine Konzerte – von intimen Clubs bis zu ausverkauften Arenen – sind legendär. Wer einmal einer seiner Shows beigewohnt hat, weiß von der intensiven Atmosphäre und der Unvergesslichkeit eines solchen Abends: Egal, ob in einem kleinen Club oder vor tausenden Menschen, die auf dem Höhepunkt eines Festivals an seinen Lippen hängen und jede Zeile mitsingen. Mit fast einer Million verkaufter Alben und über 500 Live-Auftritten hat er bewiesen: Seine Musik berührt alle. 

Am 23.10.2026 erscheint sein 5. Studioalbum „Gute Zeiten“, ein Werk, das in einer Zeit gesellschaftlicher Spaltung Hoffnung, Zusammenhalt und Empathie in den Mittelpunkt stellt.

title: Kiko Veneno
description:
Esencial en la música española de los últimos 50 años. Compositor inclasificable, conocedor de la tradición, pero sin miedo a reinventarse. Un mutante con un sello propio que une lo poético y lo cotidiano. Abrió senda en el flamenco-pop con "Veneno" (1977), y su participación en “La leyenda del tiempo” (1979) de Camarón ensanchó los cantes. En los 90 firmó dos álbumes que forman parte de la BSO de una generación, “Échate un cantecito” (1992) y “Está muy bien eso del cariño” (1995), éxitos y discos angulares del pop aflamencado. 
También siguieron otros caminos, como "Si tú, si yo", "El hombre Invisible", "Dice la gente”, “El pimiento indomable”, o sus últimas sorpresas: “Sombrero roto” con aires electrónicos, reconocido como uno de los LPs del 2019, y HAMBRE (2021), continuación bastarda de aquel álbum, con un sonido contemporáneo y oscuro. Para este 2026 se espera vuelta a la rumba y la alegría con un nuevo trabajo que vamos descubriendo.

description:
SARA is an alternative metal band founded in 1995 in Kaskinen, Finland. Drawing inspiration from influential metal acts such as Tool, Deftones, and Nine Inch Nails, alongside alternative rock artists including Mew and Kent, the band has developed a distinctive sound built around atmosphere, intensity, and emotional depth.

After winning the “Ääni ja vimma” competition in 1999, SARA released their debut album Narupatsaat. Known for their unique sonic identity and frontman Joa Korhonen’s distinctive vocals, the band quickly gained recognition, including an Emma Award nomination for the song “Rauhan aika.”

Their 10th studio album, Hallava, was released on January 17th, 2025, earning an Emma Award nomination in the Metal Album of the Year category. The album was also selected as Critics’ Album of the Year 2025 by Finnish music magazines Soundi and Inferno, further reinforcing SARA’s enduring impact on Finland’s alternative metal scene.

title: É O MT
description:
Natural de Serra Preta – BA, Matheus Souza, conhecido como MT, é uma das vozes mais promissoras do pagodão baiano. Aos 23 anos, o artista vem ganhando destaque com seu carisma, presença de palco e um swing que carrega a alma da Bahia. A história começou de forma simples, gravando em casa, movido pelo amor à música e pelo sonho de viver do que ama. O talento chamou atenção e logo empresários apostaram na sua caminhada, transformando o que era sonho em realidade. 
O cantor traz consigo o apoio e a energia da família de Serra Preta e divide o palco com sua irmã Vitorinha, que brilha como back vocal e é presença marcante nos shows, e quando ela entra, já se ouve o grito: “É a Vitorinha, tá?”
Entre os bordões que marcam sua carreira, MT também faz referência à sua trajetória e aos empresários que acreditaram nele, dizendo em suas músicas: “O menino de JB e de Igor Serra Preta”. Além do clássico: “É o MT, bebê!”

title: Manuel García - Topic
description:
MANUEL GARCÍA (Arica, 1970).

Trovador chileno. Ganador en 2008 del Premio Nacional de la Música, su amplia trayectoria vinculada a diferentes géneros musicales como el folk-rock latino, la canción popular, el nuevo folclore o el pop-rock electrónico, como muestra en su media docena de discos de estudio y las colaboraciones con importantes artistas siendo la más reciente con el cubano Silvio Rodríguez en una nueva versión de su tema “El Viejo Comunista (Feat. Silvio Rodríguez)”, confirmando así su entrega a proyectos enriquecedores y exitosos con artistas de indiscutible proyección, como Pedro Aznar, con quien registró el disco "Abrazo de Hermanos", las grabaciones realizadas con Mon Laferte (La Danza de las Libélulas y Cielito De Abril), la gira que realizó junto a Calle 13, sus colaboraciones con la legendaria banda Los Bunkers, el español DePedro (La Cuadra), el cubano Silvio Rodríguez o la peruana Eva Ayllón, entre otros.

En 2020 recibe el Premio Gardel a "Mejor Álbum conceptual" junto a Pedro Aznar, siendo el único chileno el citado galardón. En 2022 y 2025 recibe el premio a "Mejor cantautor" en los premios Pulsar de Chile.
 
Actualmente se encuentra finalizando su gira más exitosa: "Pánico", con motivo de los 20 años de la publicación de su primer LP. En www.manugarpez.com pueden encontrar información sobre todos sus conciertos.

description:
Yelcid Arbey Osorio Hurtado, nacido en Medellín el 7 de septiembre de 1979, es conocido como YELSID, “La Voz” del género romántico urbano en Colombia. En 2023 lanzó El Yelso, álbum de 15 canciones que recorren desde cumbia y regional mexicano hasta reguetón sin perder su esencia romántica. En 2024 presentó Mi Mejor Regalo, balada íntima dedicada a sus hijos, reafirmando su vigencia y versatilidad. Orgulloso de sus raíces antioqueñas, Yelsid mezcla pasión, despecho y romanticismo, consolidándose como una voz única y referente de la música urbana colombiana.

title: Banda Cuisillos - Topic
description:
Banda Cuisillos: El Gran Ritual Musical
Fundada en 1987 por iniciativa de Arturo Macías en Cuisillos, Jalisco, "La Tribu" comenzó como un sueño juvenil que animaba desfiles y festividades locales. Tras años de sacrificios para adquirir sus instrumentos, la agrupación dio el salto profesional a principios de los 90. Su primer gran éxito, "El Perro Aguayo", les otorgó proyección internacional, consolidándose después con temas como "Las Mil y Una Noches".

Reconocimientos y Versatilidad
La originalidad de Cuisillos radica en su capacidad de innovar, mezclando el romanticismo de baladas como "A veces lloro" con la energía de sus cumbias y temas vanguardistas. Esta versatilidad les ha permitido cosechar grandes éxitos:

Premios: Ganadores de un Latin Grammy por el álbum Puras Rancheras y múltiples nominaciones.

Distinciones: Nombrados "Máximo Orgullo Hispano" en Las Vegas y receptores de las llaves de ciudades como Los Ángeles y Chicago.

Impacto Digital: En 2021, su tema "Cánchame" se volvió viral con el #AdivinaDondeEstoyChallenge, superando millones de reproducciones.

Escenarios y Colaboraciones
A lo largo de su carrera, han colaborado con figuras como Pancho Barraza y Luis Ángel "El Flaco". Han conquistado recintos icónicos desde el Rosemont Theatre en EE. UU. hasta lograr Sold Outs en el Auditorio Telmex y la Arena CDMX. Actualmente, promocionan "Vamos A Platicar" junto a Los Socios del Ritmo, continuando el legado de "El Gran Ritual".

title: Ender Balkır - Topic
description:
10 Şubat 1977 de Tunceli’nin Mazgirt ilçesinde doğdu. Adıyla birlikte kulağına türküler fısıldandı. Önce tahtadan yaptığı sazıyla türküler söyledi. Sonra türküyle sevdalanışı bir tutkuya dönüşünce, konservatuvara gitmek istedi. Ailesinden destek görmeyen Ender Balkır eğitimine 19 Mayıs Üniversitesi Matematik Bölümü'nde devam etti. Üniversite yıllarında müzik mesaisine hiç ara vermedi. Matematik eğitimin ardından İstanbul’a atanan Ender Balkır 2001-2004 yılları arasında matematik öğretmenliği yaptı. Müzik tutkusu ağır basan yorumcu görevinden istifa ederek profesyonel olarak müzikle ilgilenmeye başladı. Birçok konser, radyo-tv programı ve seçkin mekânlarda kazandığı sahne deneyiminin ardından 2007 yılında ilk albümü “Ezim Ezim” i çıkardı.
Ender Balkır, söylediği türkülerle Türkiye’nin önemli dizilerinin sesi oldu. “Hanımın Çiftliği, Dila Hanım, Ustura Kemal, Düriye'nin Güğümleri,Öyle Bir Geçer Zamanki,Poyraz Karayel” dizilerinde söylediği türküler, hikâyeleri daha dokunaklı kıldı. Sesi, dizi severlerin yüreğinde sahneleri bütünleyen bir enstrümana dönüştü.
Yorumcu, Türkiye’nin dört yanından sevilen türküleri seslendirdiği albümü “Ahir” ve Harput türkülerinden oluşan ve Kalan müzik etiketiyle çıkan ''HARPUT'' albümü ile müzik yolculuğunun sonsuz olmasını ümit ediyor.
         Çukur Dizisinde seslendirdiği “Ruhumda Sızı” türküsüyle herkesin gönlümde taht kurdu ve uzun süre müzik listelerinin enlerinde yer aldı.

Georgios Kyriacos Panayiotou (25 June 1963–25 December 2016), known professionally as George Michael, was an English singer, songwriter, record producer, and philanthropist who rose to fame as a member of the music duo Wham! Up to the time of his death, Michael sold more than 115 million records worldwide, making him one of the best-selling music artists of all time. His breakthrough duo Wham! sold 28 million records between 1982 and 1986, and his debut solo album Faith sold more than 20 million copies worldwide. Michael achieved seven number one singles in the UK and eight number one songs on the Billboard Hot 100 in the US, including "Careless Whisper" and "Praying for Time". He ranks among the best-selling British acts of all time, and won various music awards throughout his 30-year career.

title: DADAY Music
description:
Découvrez l'univers envoûtant de Daday.
Artiste originaire de Mayotte, nourri par les mélodies envoûtantes des musiques traditionnelles mahoraises, malgaches et comoriennes, Daday a hérité de la passion de son père, lui-même musicien jouant au "Gabussi". 

Il commence tout naturellement en 2012 influencé par la Dancehall jamaïcaine, les rythmes et les sonorités vibrantes des DROM. Egalement inspiré des mélodies Afrobeats/Afro fusion et des rythmes des pays de l'est du continent africain. Aujourd'hui, la musique de Daday fusionne toutes ces influences pour offrir une expérience musicale moderne et originale.

Polyglotte, il jongle aussi bien avec le français, l'anglais, le shimaoré, le créole et même le patois jamaïcain pour écrire des textes captivants et créer une atmosphère enivrante.

Rejoignez la communauté de Daday et laissez-vous emporter par sa passion musicale contagieuse. Découvrez son univers artistique, ses clips inspirants et ses performances scéniques.

FALLING IN REVERSE return with 2024’s Popular Monster, the postmodern trailblazer’s first full-length in seven years. The album arrives armed with no less than three RIAA-certified gold singles (“ZOMBIFIED,” “Voices in My Head,” “Watch the World Burn”), the double-platinum title track, a reimagined nü-metal classic, and six brand new anthems of furious metal, melody, and hip-hop. 

Popular Monster is a defiant statement and triumphant victory for singer, songwriter, bandleader, and provocateur Ronnie Radke, who invented Falling In Reverse inside a prison cell. 

Radke fills the fifth full-length from Falling In Reverse with invincible and irresistible songs that resonate across generations and genres. Co-produced with longtime collaborator Tyler Smyth (I Prevail, Skillet, Lights), Popular Monster is full of confessional angst, bravado, and clever wordplay. 

Ronnie formed a series of pop-punk bands in Las Vegas as a teenager, culminating in the creation of Escape The Fate. The metalcore group’s meteoric rise coincided with the singer’s spiral into addiction. By the time he was sentenced to two years in prison, the band he started had moved on without him. Some fans, critics, and industry types figured his story would end there.

description:

身兼流行歌手、時裝達人、電影演員、編劇、導演及監製，麥浚龍從2002年晉身娛樂圈以來，事業上一直力求作多面發展。 麥浚龍1984年生於香港，於溫哥華長大，2002年加入環球唱片以歌手身份出道，2004年轉投Silly Thing銳意邁向非主流的實驗性音樂路線，並開始監製自己的唱片與拍攝音樂錄像，其中以專輯「Chapel of Dawn: Chapter One」最能體現他的暗黑音樂風格，此大碟囊括了多位日本著名音樂大師包括高木完、You the Rock及 Shinco@Schadarapper一同合作，並於全球多個主要城市作銷售。 正式進軍大銀幕的首兩部電影均為彭浩翔執導，包括喜劇《破事兒》(2007)與極具爭議性的《維多利亞壹號》(2010)。麥浚龍旋即與導演黃精甫組成合作伙伴，帶來了兩部電影作品：自編自演血腥驚慄之作《復仇者之死》(2010)是麥浚龍原創故事，為他贏得韓國富川國際奇幻電影節最佳男主角的獎項，同時導演黃精甫更獲得MOSCOW SILVER GEORGE AWARD最佳導演，而本片亦獲得莫斯科國際電影節俄羅斯電影評論二級榮譽。 麥浚龍與導演黃精甫再度合作的另一部作品《保衛戰隊之出動喇！朋友！》(2011)則由陳自強聯合監製，是一部向超人動畫致敬的玩味之作。本片同時為麥浚龍2011年成立晉弘影業有限公司的創業作品。 預計2013年上映的最新電影《殭屍(Rigor Mortis)》以1985年的《殭屍先生》為藍本，重新演繹中國活跳屍經典。麥浚龍將以此首部執導的長片慶祝出道十週年，自編自導之餘亦邀得《咒怨》導演清水崇擔任聯合監製，更找來當年主要演員再度參與本片演出。

title: Cyndi Lauper - Topic
description:
Cyndi Lauper is a groundbreaking Grammy, Emmy, and Tony Award-winning songwriter and performing artist with global record sales in excess of 50 million. Her iconic voice, influential punk glamour, and infectious live shows have catapulted her to stardom. Lauper won the Grammy Award for Best New Artist with her first album, She's So Unusual, and became the first woman in history to have four top-five singles from a debut album. Since then, Lauper has released ten additional studio albums, yielding timeless classics like “Time After Time” and “True Colors,” and the anthemic “Girls Just Wanna Have Fun.” She’s been nominated for 15 Grammy Awards, two American Music Awards, seven American Video Awards, and 18 MTV Awards. In 2013, Cyndi Lauper became the first solo woman to win Best Original Score (music and lyrics) for Kinky Boots. She contributed a Tony-nominated song to the score of the Broadway musical SpongeBob SquarePants and is currently writing the score for the Broadway adaptation of the 1988 feature film Working Girl. 

A pillar of female success, Lauper was inducted to the Songwriters Hall of Fame in 2015, released a New York Times best-selling memoir, and continues to collect impressive accolades across the music industry and beyond. In 2018, Lauper designed and launched a sold-out Home Decor Collection with Grandin Road and added a guest starring role on CBS’ hit TV show Magnum PI to her acting resume. She closed out 2018 by receiving the “Icon Award” from Billboard at its 13th annual Women In Music event and brought down the house with a rousing tribute to Cher at Kennedy Center Honors. 

In addition, Lauper is tireless in her advocacy work. She has been an activist since day one, always fighting for the underdog - especially women, people living with HIV/AIDS, and LGBTQ people. Her commitment runs so deep that she started her own charity, the True Colors United in 2008 to bring an end to homelessness amongst LGBTQ youth, who make up to 40% of the youth homelessness population. 

Over the past 10 years, the True Colors United has had an indelible impact on ending youth homelessness in America. description: Soroush Lashkary better known by his stage name, Hichkas (nobody in Persian) is an Iranian song writer, rapper, record producer. Dubbed the godfather of Iranian rap and pioneer of Iranian hip-hop genre, Hichkas’s early releases combined traditional Iranian instruments and urban beats to create a hybrid genre, a combination of east and west. Lyrically, Hichkas’s songs are full of idioms, onomatopoeia, similes, alliteration, assonance, metaphors, a play on folk Persian proverbs and themed around social and cultural issues. Hichkas’s first album ‘Jangale Asfalt’ (The Asphalt Jungle) was initially released in 2005 was seminal in that it was the first professional hip-hop LP to be released from Iran, and became a fine example of Iranian arts and culture. Hichkas also, founded 021, Candis and the record label Saamet. Hichkas is working on his highly anticipated second LP, Mojaz.

title: Kemmler - Topic
description:
Imposant son univers de faiseur de chansons rap à travers des albums tels que "Rose", "Gris Cœur", "&Moi" et "Alain", Kemmler donne la part belle à l’introspection — la vie, l’amour, l’amitié, les échecs. Sa plume minimaliste, empreinte d’émotion brute, l’a amené à collaborer avec des pairs reconnus Mosimann, Youssoupha, Léa Castel, Sofiane (Fianso), Kik, Chilla, A2H, Amir, Emma Peters, Loud ou Naë...

Sa dernière œuvre, "Alain" poursuit ce travail de polisseur de mots, né d’un bouleversement personnel qui le pousse à délaisser la musique pour la première fois depuis une décennie. Fraîchement auréolé du succès de sa tournée "Alainfini", Kemmler a également surpris le public avec "Si j’avais arrêté le rap" — une mini-série de huit épisodes imaginant la vie qu’il aurait pu mener en laissant tout tomber.

À l’aube de 2025, Kemmler reste cet artisan de la rime et des émotions, puisant dans ses hauts et ses bas la matière pour toucher son public. Il poursuit un chemin singulier, entre pudeur et passion, porté par un rap à hauteur d’homme qui parle à tous ceux qui, un jour, ont vacillé pour mieux se relever.

title: Kiko Rodriguez - Topic
description:
Kiko Rodríguez, nació en Tamboril, Santiago de los Caballeros, República Dominicana. Desde la edad de 10 años, Kiko Rodríguez sintió que la música, en este caso la bachata o música de amargue, le tocaba el corazón, lo que motivó el jovencito a practicar con instrumentos de percusión, aunque después se interesó por la guitarra, que mas tarde lo inspiró y acompañó en el plasme de sus canciones. Realizó su primera presentación cuando tenía 12 años de edad, la cual abrió las puertas a lo que es hoy en día la exitosa carrera de Kiko Rodríguez, que siendo en ese entonces muy joven, sentía todo el deseo y la necesidad de ayudar a su familia a través de la música que humildemente interpretaba.

Mas tarde, Kiko ingresa a la rondallita de la parroquia de Canca Arriba, Tamboril, donde estuvo alrededor de seis años. Durante todo ese tiempo Kiko pudo madurar integra y musicalmente hablando, ya que en ese espacio de tiempo, Kiko, junto a un grupo de amigos y familiares, planificó la formación de una agrupación musical. Luego de haber concretado la idea de formar una agrupación, Kiko debutó con "Los Modernos Del Amargue", conjunto en el que Kiko se destacó mucho por su estilo único de expresar los sentimientos a través de la música de amargue (Bachata).

description: Boza nació en Panamá como Humberto Ceballos e inició su carrera en el género urbano en el 2014. Ha logrado ocupar importantes puestos de los listados de radio y plataformas de streaming gracias a un estilo original que fusiona el dancehall con el estilo panameño conocido como canela. En abril del 2019 firmó contrato con Sony Music Entertainment Centroamérica y Caribe. Tras el éxito de temas como “Lollipop”, “Me Mató” y “Party En Mi Casa”, el artista goza de gran reconocimiento en su país natal en el que destaca como uno de los principales exponentes del género. En el mes de octubre, “Party En Mi Casa” recibió la certificación Oro en Centroamérica por sus reproducciones digitales (streams). En julio del 2020, el cantante y compositor panameño presentó el álbum "Más Negro Que Rojo", un trabajo que refleja su crecimiento como artista. Tras lanzar el sencillo “Bandida” como punta de lanza y obtener puestos relevantes en plataformas de streaming en Panamá, Boza estrenó el segundo corte promocional, “Hecha Pa’ Mi”, un HIT que logró posicionarse en los charts tops y virales de las plataformas digitales GLOBALES. El rápido crecimiento del consumo de sus sencillos llevó a Boza a ser invitado por Spotify a participar de su campaña Generación Radar 2020, junto con 35 artistas emergentes de distintos países.

title: Rachel Novaes - Topic
description:
Rachel Novaes iniciou sua trajetória musical na infância, influenciada pela mãe, professora de piano. Aos 9 anos, entrou para o grupo de louvor da igreja. Mais tarde, gravou 3 CDs na Comunidade da Graça de Ubatuba.

Após, lançou 4 álbuns solo. Em “Ao Rei”, apresentou “Confiar”, inspirada em uma fase difícil, quando enfrentou dificuldades para engravidar. Hoje, é mãe de Samuel e Beatriz.

Em 2020, durante a pandemia, Rachel e seu esposo, Marcelo, realizaram lives que reuniram mais de meio milhão de espectadores, chamando a atenção da Musile Records. A parceria começou em 2022, com o EP O Amor de Deus (Ao Vivo).

Em 2023, gravou Ao Vivo nos EUA, com participações de Fernandinho e Thamires Garcia. Em 2025, apresentou Uma Voz, Uma Lembrança e Uma Canção, com sete releituras acústicas de louvores que marcaram fases importantes de sua vida.

Atualmente, Rachel celebra 25 anos de ministério com um projeto de 15 músicas, divididas em 5 blocos temáticos. “Promessa”, o 1º deles, trouxe Eu e Minha Casa (Ao Vivo), Ele Vem Pra Te Salvar (He Will Come and Save You) (Ao Vivo) e Confiar / Tu És Fiel, Senhor (Ao Vivo). Agora, “Presença” traz Tudo Novo/Maranata (Ao Vivo), com participação da FHOP Music. Durante a gravação o grupo criou o espontâneo “Maranata”, que se uniu à composição de Rachel e Hananiel Eduardo, formando o medley que dá nome à faixa. A sequência também reúne novas versões de Comigo Estás (Ao Vivo) e Alegria/Sou Feliz (Ao Vivo).

Born in Dawson, Ga., Otis Redding, Jr. and his family moved to Macon when he was two years old. At an early age, he began his career as a singer and musician in the choir of the Vineville Baptist Church. He attended Ballard Hudson High School and participated in the school band. As a teenager, he began to compete in the Douglass Theatre talent shows for the five-dollar prize. After winning 15 times straight, Otis was no longer allowed to compete.

Otis joined Johnny Jenkins and the Pinetoppers in 1958, and would also sing at the “Teenage Party” talent shows sponsored by local celebrity disc jockey King Bee, Hamp Swain, on Saturday mornings initially at the Roxy Theater and later at the Douglass Theatre in Macon.

Otis drove Johnny Jenkins to Memphis, Tenn., for a recording session in August 1962 at Stax Records. At the end of the session, Stax co-owner Jim Stewart allowed Otis to cut a couple of songs with the remaining studio time. The result was “These Arms Of Mine”, released in 1962. This was the first of many hit singles (including classics “I’ve Been Loving You Too Long”, “respect” and “Try A Little Tenderness”) that Redding enjoyed during his tragically short career. After nine months, he was invited to perform at the Apollo Theatre for a live recording and would go on to showcase his dance movements with “Shake” and “Satisfaction.”

After years of ambition and drive, Otis Redding’s sacrifices paid off. He appeared throughout the United States, Canada, Europe, and the Caribbean. His concert tours were among the biggest box office smashes of any touring performer during his time. He was nominated in three categories by the National Academy of Recording Arts & Sciences (NARAS) for recordings he made during 1967. 1968 was destined to be the greatest year of his career with appearances slated at such locations at New York’s Philharmonic Hall and Washington’s Constitution Hall. Redding was booked for several major television network appearances including The Ed Sullivan Show and The Smothers Brothers Show. He was posthumously inducted into the Georgia Music Hall of Fame in 1981 and the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame in 1989. In 1999, he was recognized with a Lifetime Achievement Grammy Award.

En el 2011 fueron nominados a importantes reconocimientos, LOS PREMIOS NUESTRA TIERRA y LOS PREMIOS SHOCK.
En el 2014 asistieron a uno de los eventos más importantes de la música en Latinoamérica el FESTIVAL INTERNACIONAL DE VIÑA DEL MAR,  donde compartieron con grandes artistas y además interpretaron la canción del momento "TE PINTARON PAJARITOS", canción que se ha convertido en un clásico del reggaetón, Esta presentación los hace acreedores de dos Galardones, Antorcha de Plata y Antorcha de Oro.

Keskin (real name Yuşa Keskin) is a Turkish rapper and songwriter recognized as one of the rising figures in the Turkish rap scene. Born on November 30, 2001, in the Cedit neighborhood of Samsun, he developed an interest in music at an early age.

Keskin began his independent music journey in 2017 by founding his own collective, Samsun Mafia Music. In 2019, he joined RedKeys Music, where he released his first official works in 2020, steadily expanding his listener base during this period.

A major turning point in his career came in 2022 with the release of the project “Silahlar İhanet Etmez.” Following this release, Keskin entered a new phase in his career by joining Hawks Company, founded by Hamza Ayazoğlu.

Known for his harsh lyrical expression, realistic storytelling, and dark atmosphere, Keskin has established a distinctive place in the contemporary Turkish rap scene through music centered on street culture. He continues his career actively under the umbrella of Hawks Company.

title: Guitarricadelafuente - Topic
description:
Guitarricadelafuente es un músico suspendido entre dos mundos. Creció entre la localidad costera de Benicàssim y el pueblo de su abuela, Las Cuevas de Cañart, rodeado de ecos de cultura popular rural y flamenco. Ese cruce de caminos marcó su identidad y dio forma a una voz que conecta con el limbo emocional de una generación atrapada entre el anhelo genuino y la sobrecarga digital. 
 
Su nombre artístico —una fusión entre su apellido, Lafuente, y el diminutivo aragonés de guitarra, “guitarrica”— se dio a conocer con “El Conticinio”, grabada en su habitación en 2018 con un micrófono de PlayStation. Su sonido lo-fi y su crudeza emocional marcaron el tono de un artista que ha hecho de la intimidad su lenguaje. Años más tarde, esa misma grabación fue elegida para un anuncio de Apple dirigido por Spike Jonze y protagonizado por Pedro Pascal, confirmando su proyección internacional. 
 
En 2019 irrumpió con canciones como “Guantanamera” y “Nana Triste” (con Natalia Lacunza), y en 2022 lanzó La Cantera, un debut aclamado que fusiona folclore, poesía y sensibilidad contemporánea. Su segundo álbum, Spanish Leather (2025), con portada de Wolfgang Tillmans, da un paso adelante en sonido y lenguaje visual, reafirmando a un artista que evoluciona sin perder su raíz.

title: Rupatrupa
description:
Rupatrupa es un proyecto musical independiente y autogestionado dirigido por Roberto Ruido (Roberto González Berenguer, Madrid, 1989). Se utilizan ritmos muy conocidos, como el reggae, el ska o la rumba, pero llevándolos siempre a un terreno propio y apostando de manera fiel por un sonido crudo, acústico y real.

Rupatrupa nació en las calles de La Laguna, Tenerife, pero poco a poco, y con mucho trabajo, ha llegado a tener una proyección internacional poco común en proyectos de estas características. De hecho, en Latinoamérica reside la mayor parte del público de Rupatrupa, siendo Colombia el país que más escucha y arropa al proyecto afincado en Canarias.

Roberto ha conseguido con sus letras y sus melodías crear un universo propio donde todo cabe, y esto genera en muchas personas la misma duda: ¿Qué estilo es Rupatrupa? No parece haber una respuesta sencilla a esta pregunta, y eso es lo que hace especial a este proyecto.

His solo debut came in 2008 with "Massacre Musical," reaching #46 on the Billboard Top Latin Albums chart. His single “Tu Te Imaginas” hit #33 on the Billboard Hot Latin Tracks chart, cementing his reputation. Over the next decade, De La Ghetto released numerous successful tracks and collaborations, frequently appearing on Billboard's Hot Latin chart. Those include hits like “Acercate” (2016), “La Ocasion” (2016), “La Formula” (2017), and “Dime” (2018). He has worked with top artists garnering over 20 million monthly listeners. In 2019, he earned Latin GRAMMY nominations for “Best Urban Music Album” for "Mi Movimiento" and “Best Urban Song” for "Caliente" featuring J Balvin. His single “Loco Por Perrearte (Remix)” ft. Rauw Alejandro (2022), achieved platinum status. In 2023, De La Ghetto released "GZ," his first album under his own label. The 12-track album has the standout single "My Love" showcasing his innovative style. De La Ghetto's creative approach and dedication to authenticity continue to redefine Latin music, making him a pioneering artist in the industry.

description:
ll a traversé les générations et les tendances pour s'imposer comme l'une des figures majeures du rap français. Avec plus de 20 ans de carrière, près de 1,5 million de disques vendus et plusieurs certifications Or et Platine, Sinik fait partie des artistes qui ont marqué durablement l'âge d'or du Rap FR des années 2000.
Révélé au grand public avec le mythique street CD "En Attendant l'Album", puis consacré par le succès de "La Main sur le Cœur", Sinik s'est imposé grâce à une plume authentique, des punchlines mémorables et un storytelling qui ont marqué toute une génération.
Auteur de classiques incontournables comme "Une Époque Formidable", "Je Réalise" avec James Blunt, "Ne Dis Jamais" avec Vitaa, "De Tout Là-Haut" avec Kayna Samet, "Le Même Sang" avec Diam's ou encore "L'Assassin", Sinik demeure l'une des références du rap français pour les amateurs de textes, de technique et d'émotion.
Figure emblématique des années 2000, il a également marqué l'histoire du Rap FR par ses clashs devenus cultes, notamment face à Booba, dans une période souvent considérée comme l'âge d'or du rap français.
Après plus de 800 concerts à travers la France et la francophonie, l'auteur d'"Autodestruction" continue d'incarner un rap sincère, sans artifice, porté par une écriture incisive et une identité artistique unique.

title: Eleni Foureira - Topic
description:
Eleni Foureira (born 7 March 1987 in Fier, Albania) is a pop singer, actress and show-woman in the Balkan territory.
From the early stages of her career in Greece, she was crowned the Pop Queen of the Greek music scene, with local fans and media anointing her with the title of #Queen. 
Foureira signed her first record contract in Greece in 2010, where she released her debut album which went multi-platinum in Greece and Cyprus.
After her debut success, Foureira signed a new record contract and went on to release her next two studio albums “Ti poniro mou zitas” (2012) and “Anemos agapis” (2014), which were well-received in Greece and Cyprus.
Foureira made her way into the international scene by sharing the stage with the popular musician, singer, songwriter and record producer Dan Balan for the performance of 2010 massive hit: Chica Bomb. In 2013 Eleni Foureira and Alex Leon released the first official cover of the song “To deserve you” (Original: Bette Midler), which was well-received worldwide. Following up this success, Foureira collaborated in 2014 with the famous reggaeton singer J. Balvin, when they performed live one of the year’s top summer hits “Tranquila”. 
Foureira in 2015 signed a 360o management and record deal with Panik Records leading to her music career take-off. Her fourth studio album “Vasilissa” was released in late 2017 and included single-hits, such as “Ti Koitas”, “Sto Theo Me Paei” and “Vasilissa”. 
Foureira’s releases quickly climb to the top of the national airplay, physical and digital charts, while she headlines and performs in numerous sold out concerts and events across the Balkans. Her performance and dancing skills highlight every Music Video she releases, resulting to millions of views on the YouTube platform!
In February 2018, CyBC and Panik Records announced that Eleni Foureira will be representing Cyprus at the Eurovision Song Contest 2018, with the song “Fuego”, written by Alex Papaconstantinou, Geraldo Sandell, Viktor Svensson, Anderz Wrethov & Didrick.

description:
G.E.M. 現時是大中華地區最賣座的女歌手之一，2008年，16歲的她於香港出道，旋即以極富力量和穿透力的聲線征服廣大樂迷，並橫掃多個流行榜獎項。

G.E.M. 演出經驗非常豐富，除了在中國內地的一系列表演外，還包括為期兩年的國外巡迴演出，年僅27歲，G.E.M.已經在澳洲、加拿大、馬來西亞、新西蘭、美國及英國等多個地方，舉辦超過140場演出。除此以外，G.E.M.也是串流平台Spotify上，累積最多播放次數的中國女歌手之一，歌曲MV亦於YouTube共得超過15億次觀看，令她成為該平台。首位擁有4首作品衝破1億次播放的大中華地區歌手。

G.E.M. 的音樂影響力無遠弗屆，除了為她贏得福布斯《30 Under 30》名人榜一席位外，也令她成為「美國太空總署美國科學突破獎」及英國BBC「年度百大女性」的得主，肯定了她在全球樂壇的貢獻和實力。

One of China’s top-selling female artists, G.E.M. made her debut in the Hong Kong music scene in 2008 at the of age 16, stunning fans with her beautiful and powerful voice. 

She has toured extensively in China and has performed a series of shows internationally including a two-year world tour playing shows in countries such as Australia, Canada, Malaysia, New Zealand, United Kingdom and the United States. By the age of 27, she had already held over 140 concerts around the globe. She is the one of the most streamed female Chinese singer on Spotify, and holds the record for the most viewed female Chinese singer on YouTube, having achieved over 1.5 billion channel views. She is also the first to have four music videos that generated more than 100 million views on the platform.

In addition, G.E.M. made it onto the Forbes China celebrity list, and the Forbes 30 Under 30 Music List. She was the first Asian artist to have performed at the prestigious NASA Breakthrough Prizes Awards, and has appeared on the BBC’s 100 Women list which highlights 100 inspiring and influential women from around the world.

title: Damaris Guerra - Topic
description:
Damaris Guerra is a independent artist, a bilingual singer/songwriter with Mexican decent born in San Antonio, Tx but raised on the road traveling with her family. Her Father Rudy Guerra is a traveling Evangelist who was also a professional musician back in the 60’s. Her musical style is a fusion of contemporary pop and latin pop. She has been singing since she was 4 years old, she was in a pop vocal band with her siblings for nine years and eventually became a solo recording artist. She never thought she would become a Latin artist but after receiving an invitation by a Latin Christian music label to record & release her first Spanish album in 2013, it lit a passion in her heart for Latin America. Her outgoing, loud and confident personality is complimentary to her dynamic vocal range, transparency & vulnerability when ministering.

Damaris’ debut album "Mi Todo" kicked off her singing career in 2013 and she later garnered fans via YouTube in 2014 with her Inspirational song, "Buscando Una Señal.” The music video gained over 64 million views to date via YouTube. The message of hope and trust that this song portrays continues to thrive and touch hearts around the world. 
Her most recent single titled "Free Fall" was her very first crossover into the English music industry. A song she later went on to translate in Spanish titled “Me Entrego.” 

She has been overwhelmed in the best way by all the love and support of her fans, family & friends.

title: Ai Higuchi - Topic
description:
平成元年生まれ。シンガーソングライター。
生まれは香川、育ちは長野、大学進学のため上京し、東京在住。
2歳のころからピアノを習い、その後ヴァイオリン・合唱・声楽・ドラム・ギターなどを経験、様々な音楽に触れる。
18歳より鍵盤弾き語りをメインとして活動を開始。
メロディアスな高速ピアノリフに乗せた、まっすぐに伸びるアルトヴォイス。
ピアノと一体になった小さな身体から振り絞られる熱情が、時にたおやかな美しさを、時に心かきむしられる焦燥を、時に喪失の中の光を描く。
独特の視点で綴る歌詞世界は、ありふれた日常の風景を短編小説のようにドラマチックに昇華させる。
音楽性の高さ以上に、叱咤激励にも似たその歌声は老若男女問わずじわじわと中毒者を増やし続けている。

Born the first year of the Heisei era. Singer/songwriter.
She entered this world in Kagawa, was raised in Nagano and came to Tokyo for school. Her musical studies began at the age of 2 with classical piano and quickly expanded to include violin, drums, guitar and voice training. When she turned 18, she decided to concentrate on the keyboard.
Her melodious and high-speed piano riffs perfectly complement an alto voice that climbs relentlessly. Becoming one with the piano, she wrenches passion from it, yet at times illustrating an exquisite grace, fear and the light that appears from loss. Her unique insight allows her to compose lyrics that heighten drama in scenes from everyday life, much like a short story.
Central to her core is a self-affirming desire that can never be satisfied. The gorgeous quality of her music and infectious enthusiasm continuously add to her legion of fans.

title: NOVUM - Topic
description:
Juan José Umaña, mejor conocido como NOVUM, es un cantautor costarricense que destaca como una de las voces emergentes más prometedoras de la escena urbana en Costa Rica. Originario del cantón de Turrubares, NOVUM no solo es pionero en llevar la música urbana fuera de las fronteras de su comunidad, sino que también ha logrado consolidarse como una figura clave en el panorama musical nacional, obteniendo en el proceso un Premio ACAM en el 2024 por su aporte al Hip-Hop en Costa Rica.

Su propuesta artística combina géneros como el rap en español, el reggaetón, el reggae y las baladas acústicas, reflejando una versatilidad que lo distingue. Inspirado por la esencia del boom bap y otros ritmos urbanos, NOVUM utiliza su música para transmitir mensajes auténticos y conectar profundamente con su audiencia.

Actualmente como miembro de 953, NOVUM continúa expandiendo su trayectoria, apostando por nuevas sonoridades y propuestas creativas que enriquecen el movimiento musical del país, posicionándose en colaboraciones junto a artistas destacados de la región e incluso con solo 20 años de edad, participando como telonero de artistas internacionales de renombre mundial.

title: Mr Eazi - Topic
description:
Mr Eazi is a musical innovator, business leader, and philanthropist. A Nigerian multi-hyphenate, he is the voice behind seminal Afropop hits such as "Pour Me Water," "Skin Tight," and "Leg Over," as well as groundbreaking collaborations with the likes of Beyoncé and J Balvin. He is also the creator of Banku Music, a fusion of Ghanaian and Nigerian sounds and culture. To date, he has amassed over 4 billion streams of his songs across digital music platforms, making him one of the most streamed African artists worldwide.
In addition to his musical achievements, Mr Eazi is a successful entrepreneur who has founded several groundbreaking ventures. In 2018, he founded emPawa Africa, a talent incubator program aimed at guiding and accelerating the careers of African artists. The program's innovative approach to expanding African music's global reach has earned Mr Eazi and emPawa Africa recognition from major media outlets like CNN, Rolling Stone, Billboard, and Forbes.
He is also the founder of Zagadat Capital, a venture capital fund launched in 2021. Through this fund, he has invested in numerous African tech startups, demonstrating his commitment to supporting African entrepreneurship. 
Despite his focus on business ventures and expanding opportunities for African creatives, Mr Eazi has not lost touch with his own music. In 2023, he will be releasing two full-length album projects.

Miguel Morales "La Voz" es uno de los más destacados cantantes de la música Vallenata. Nació en Valledupar, Cesar. Kanner Y Keyner “Los K Morales” formaron esta exitosa agrupación, que hoy es reconocida en Colombia y el mundo por su estilo único.

Привіт, я Zora Lina.

Моя музика — це не продюсерський проєкт, а історії, що виросли з реального життя. Я довго шукала себе у роботі й буденних турботах, доки не зрозуміла: мій голос звучить найгучніше, коли я говорю про справжні почуття без прикрас.

У моїх піснях — спостереження, емоції та сцени з життя, де завжди є місце і сміху, і самоіронії, і глибоким роздумам. Не для моди, а тому що так звучить моя душа.

Тут немає масок і вигаданих ролей. Тільки щирість: про стосунки, дорослішання, теплі моменти та те, що переживає кожен з нас, але не завжди наважується сказати вголос.

title: PARTYNEXTDOOR - Topic
description:
Hailing from Mississauga, Canada, OVO Sound’s PARTYNEXTDOOR is one of this generation’s most important R&B singers, songwriters and producers. His Jamaican roots inform much of his music, and his influence can be heard across contemporary R&B, rap, and pop genres today. In 2013, PARTYNEXTDOOR was the first artist signed to OVO Sound and released his seminal debut PARTYNEXTDOOR. 2014 saw the release of his second project PARTYNEXTDOOR TWO, which he followed with the Colours EP the same year. He followed P2 with the PARTYNEXTDOOR 3 LP in 2016 to widespread critical acclaim. 

In 2017, PND released his Seven Days EP, the same year he earned a "Best R&B Song" GRAMMY Award nomination for the triple-platinum certified “Come and See Me” with Drake. Also known for his prolific output and songcraft, PND wrote Rihanna’s 2016 smash “Work,” which topped the Billboard Hot 100 chart, as well as DJ Khaled’s 2017 hit “Wild Thoughts,” featuring Rihanna, which peaked #2 on the Hot 100. 

Most recently, he released “THE NEWS” and “LOYAL (feat. Drake)” in 2019, as well as “SPLIT DECISION” and a “LOYAL” remix featuring Bad Bunny. His latest album PARTYMOBILE was released in March 2020.

title: Marc Scibilia - Topic
description:
Born and raised in Buffalo, NY, chart-topping singer/songwriter Marc Scibilia’s been on a steady rise ever since the 2012 release of his breakout single, “How Bad We Need Each Other.” His music has been featured in a slew of film and television soundtracks, including a recent Water.org PSA narrated by Matt Damon; and toured with James Bay, Zac Brown Band, Butch Walker, and Nick Jonas, among others.

Scibilia was forced to put his burgeoning career on hold for the better part of 2019, though, when he welcomed his first child into the world while simultaneously caring for his ailing father, who would tragically pass away from brain cancer shortly thereafter. He chronicles the profound, emotional journey on his riveting new album, ‘Seed Of Joy,’ which he recorded alone in his basement studio in Nashville in the midst of the COVID-19 pandemic. While you might expect the finished product to be a dark and somber affair, ‘Seed Of Joy’ is, true to its name, just the opposite, fueled by soulful vocals and soaring melodies and overflowing with rich, anthemic exuberance at nearly every turn. Calling to mind everything from Paul Simon and Cat Stevens to Bleachers and Vampire Weekend, the result is a powerful slice of self-reflection that balances nostalgia and optimism in equal measure, a thoughtful, defiantly optimistic work that insists on finding silver linings, even in the face of gut-wrenching loss.

ベーシストでありコンポーザー、アレンジャーの中村正人と ヴォーカリストでありコンポーザー・パフォーマーである吉田美和の二人からなるDREAMS COME TRUE。 二人であることを核に、楽曲のクリエイトにおいては時代を睨みながら模索しつつも、 結成当時から「ポップスの追求」「血湧き肉躍るライヴ」を両輪として活動を続けています。

2024年デビュー35周年を迎え、 2025年は、「ここからだ︕」（大阪・関西万博開催記念「EXPO EKIDEN 2025」テーマソング）をCDリリース、 続いて「BEACON」（テレビ朝日系ドラマ『大追跡〜警視庁ＳＳＢＣ強行犯係〜』主題歌）を配信リリース。

2026年には2026年3月18日（水)には、DREAMS COME TRUE実に9年ぶり19枚目のオリジナルアルバム『THE BLACK ◯ ALBUM』（ザ ブラック アルバム）をリリース。 オープニング／エンディング／曲順／曲間／その繋がりに至るまでこだわった“ひとつなぎの音楽作品”として「まずは“CDアルバム”というカタチで伝えたい」と“CDファースト チャレンジ！”　 さらにこのアルバムを携えてのアルバムツアー「DREAMS COME TRUE CONCERT TOUR 2026」の開催を決定。これまで見たことのない驚きが詰まったステージは、絶対に見逃せないツアーになること間違いありません。

title: Heilung
description:
Heilung is sounds from the northern european iron age and viking period. We used everything from running water, human bones, reconstructed swords and shields up to ancient frame drums and bronze rings in the songs. 
The lyrics contain original texts from rune stones and preserved spear shafts, amulets and other artifacts. Furthermore poems, which either deal with historical events or are translations/ interpretations of the originals.
Every attempt to link the music to modern political or religious points are pointless, since Heilung tries to connect the listener to the time before Christianity and its political offsprings raped and burned itself into the northern european mentality.
Heilung means healing in german and describes the core of the sound. It is supposed to leave the listener eased and relaxed after a sometimes turbulent musical journey.

title: Rabito - Topic
description:
Desde muy joven su instrumento principal fue batería y comenzó tocando en grupos de música comercial grabando para la Cía RCA Víctor ( BMG).

Fue parte del elenco de artistas en la CBS y de Phillips.
Durante todo este trayecto se descubre como autor y compositor con la producción de su primer artista ( El Mismo - Rabito ) seudónimo con el cual lo bautizó un amigo.

A partir de ese momento con sus propias canciones comienza una trayectoria de éxitos en toda Latinoamerica con ventas que superaban los 250.000 copias, mas tarde visitaría dichos países para presentarse en conciertos multitudinarios, también, distintos artistas grabaron sus canciones.
Su aceptación como cantautor fue siempre grande hasta el día de hoy, el Internet es reflejo de ello.

Junto a la Cía Fonovisa, fue el promotor del inicio de los Premios Grammys para la música Gospel Latina con su producción " Sinceridad " donde recibió la nominación, ese mismo año fue premiado como el cantante cristiano # 1 y a partir de ese momento por primera vez en la historia de USA se escucharía este tipo de genero en todas las radios seculares .

Desde hace 29 años solo graba musica Gospel y esta dedicado a predicar El Evangelio de Jesus dando conciertos y conferencias en distintos países. En los últimos 20 años vive en California junto a su familia, tiene su propia Cia de Discos y su nueva producción lleva por título " Música Nueva En El Barrio " .

description: Hindusthan Records was established as a RECORD LABEL in 1932, & the studio was inaugurated by RabindraNath Tagore himself, and the company made its first recordings of Rabindranath Tagore's songs. HINDUSTHAN became a major player in the unfolding saga of India’s Music History. As early as the 1940s, the Company focused on building a repertoire of Eastern and Northern Indian recordings in Bhojpuri, U.P. Folk, Chhatisgarhi Folk, Quawalis and Religious Bhajans.

title: Duran Duran - Topic
description:
How many bands can you think of that, decades into their career, are still capable of springing surprises, of blazing fresh trails, creating new music that is up there with the imperishable songs that first propelled them to fame, fortune and critical acclaim? It’s an interesting exercise, and a brief one – a list you can make on the fingers of one hand. In 2015, Duran Duran will cement their place in that illustrious grouping with a new studio album – their 14th, no less – that burnishes their role in the story of pop, and puts the many young pretenders whose music they have influenced firmly in their place. As part of a major new recording deal with Warner Bros. Records, Paper Gods starts the next chapter in the history of the band, with a host of A-list collaborators – including Nile Rodgers, Mark Ronson, Mr Hudson, Janelle Monáe, John Frusciante, Kiesza and Davide Rossi – joining the party. “We found a whole new level of inspiration on this album,” says the band’s keyboardist and aesthetic overlord, Nick Rhodes. “We were talking the 
other day about artists that have been around for a long time – our contemporaries and some older ones, and there’s only a handful of the latter now, still out there playing shows. And we were saying, ‘What albums did they make this far down the line that we own?’ And that was a difficult one.”

Simon Le Bon has a theory as to why the band are still friends, and still making vital, compelling music, 37 years after Duran Duran first formed in Birmingham. “I think with some artists, as they get into extended careers, it’s like climbing up a rock-face – they start to look down. If you do that, musically, you’re pretty much dead in the water. You can hear it when someone’s thought about it just a little too much, or tried to write something that they think people will like, rather than something that turns them on. We’ve always written music that turns us on; we’ve never tried to tailor it to any kind of taste.” Band politics play a role, too, he says. “I think part of our strength is the tension in our music, which probably comes from the tension within the band. When you’re young, you’re not scared of upsetting people, and actually we can still push that sometimes. But harsh words are forgiven. Violette Wautier captivated the country with her audition on Season 2 of The Voice Thailand in 2013. Since then, the Thai-Belgian sensation has garnered critical acclaim and awards for both her music and acting. 

In 2018, Violette decided to release her first English-language single, “Drive”. She followed up on the success of the hit with a  track named “Smoke” the same year. “Smoke” broke the record for most views for an English song performed by a Thai artist on YouTube. The single also ranked No. 1 in 8 countries, including Thailand, Singapore and Malaysia.

Violette Wautier released her brilliant all-English album "Glitter and Smoke" debuted on June, 2020, her single "I’d Do It Again" introduced her to the listeners worldwide. In May 2021, Violette Wautier released her comeback with the long-awaited new Thai song titled "กักตัว" (means "Quarantine"), her first Thai single in 3 years. Followed by her current love ballad hit "ตั้งแต่มีเธอฉันมีความสุข (This Time)".

title: Unha Pintada - Topic
description:
Criada em Julho de 2011, a banda do cantor Unha Pintada surgiu de um sonho do trabalhador rural, Aldiran, pessoa conhecida em seu Povoado Barroca, zona rural, do município de Simão Dias, estado de Sergipe, local que é a terra natal da banda. O idealizador desse projeto não tinha nenhuma experiência nessa área de entretenimento e da música, pois, seu único ofício era a lavoura, no trabalho com a terra. Mas, com fé em seu sonho, aliado com muita determinação e perseverança, iniciou seu percurso para a concretização.
Atualmente, a banda do cantor Unha Pintada possui uma equipe de 30 profissionais, entre músicos, produção, motoristas, técnicos e auxiliares. Com uma estrutura de luz, LED, efeitos especiais e equipamentos dos mais modernos disponíveis no mercado, para realizar shows de qualidade, proporcionando, assim, uma agenda lotada e constante nos estados de Sergipe, Bahia, São Paulo e além-fronteiras.
Desde as suas primeiras aparições, o cantor Unha Pintada vem se popularizando e conquistando mais fãs, levando para seus shows, um estilo de arrocha com muito romantismo, mexendo com a emoção dos corações apaixonados, deixando suas músicas na boca do povo.
O cantor Unha Pintada tem no quadro de canções de sua autoria vários sucessos como: Amor Inesquecível, Desculpe Amor, Recairei Teste de Farmácia e várias outras músicas que estão em produção para futuros lançamentos.

description:
From Isabela, Puerto Rico, Chuwi is a quartet that masterfully blends traditional rhythms with contemporary production, creating a sound that is as soulful as it is dynamic. Chuwi’s music is a look into their cultural roots and emotions, infused with the energy and innovation of modern indie music.

The band is composed by Lorén, a powerhouse vocalist whose voice channels both raw emotion and unmistakable Caribbean warmth. Her brother, Willy, anchors their sound with his masterful bass-lines and deep soulful vocals, while their younger brother, Wester, adds vibrant textures with his keyboard melodies and redefines the live set once he takes charge of the microphone. Rounding out the quartet is family friend and percussionist Adrian, the spirit of the show, and whose command on percussion drives the group’s infectious rhythms. Willy and Wester also produce and mix the band's tracks at home where they create a special sauce that cannot be produced anywhere else.

A lo largo de su carrera se consolidó como uno de los productores más destacados de la escena, siendo responsable de éxitos como "Las leyes de la vida" junto a Benja Torres, Diego Torres y Ángela Torres; "Puñaladas" con Lauta y Amigo de Artistas; "Lady Madonna" junto a Ruggero; "Me Presento" con Maxi Espíndola y Valen Vargas; y "Brindo" junto a Benja Torres. Es también el creador de "Asado en lo de Tote", la sección donde artistas invitados se juntan, comen asado y cantan.

2021년 자이언티는 마블시네마틱 유니버스의 영화, ‘샹치와 텐 링즈의 전설’의 사운드트랙을 호시노 겐과 작업하며 글로벌 아티스트로서의 역량을 인정받았다. 같은 해 힙합 경연 프로그램 ‘쇼미더머니’에 멘토로 출연해 다시 한번 대중의 인기를 사로잡았으며, 그가 프로듀싱한 노래 ‘회전목마’는 12주 연속 빌보드 K-Pop 차트 1위를 석권하였다.

최고의 라이브 퍼포머로 손꼽히는 그는 미국 세계 최대 음악 페스티벌 ‘SXSW’ 공연을 시작으로 유럽과 아시아에서도 솔로 콘서트를 개최한 바 있다.

자이언티는 다양한 글로벌 브랜드와 협업하고, 포브스 ‘한국 파워 셀럽’ 순위에 오르는 등, 음악시장에 새로운 기준을 만들어 가고 있는 레전드 아티스트로서의 행보를 이어가고 있다.

description:
Cesar Bernales (Cesar BK), cantautor peruano, nació el 27 de noviembre de 1995 y desde muy pequeño se interesó en el mundo de la música. title: Machine Head - Topic
description:
Very few bands make it to their 11th album. Even fewer do so with the same fire and fury that defined their early years. But Machine Head isn’t just any band. For over three decades, the personification of determination, Founder/Vocalist/Guitarist Robb Flynn, has led Machine Head on an uncompromising path – one fueled by defiance, reinvention, and a relentless pursuit of evolution. Now, with ‘UNATØNED’ (out April 25, 2025 on Nuclear Blast), they’ve once again sharpened their sound into its most direct and impactful form to date.  

Determined to challenge himself, Flynn set strict songwriting parameters for ‘UNATØNED,’ shorter, more focused songs with a decidedly American feel, unconventional key changes, and shifting structures that break expectations. That self-imposed restraint resulted in a lean, unrelenting album that captures Machine Head at their most potent.   

The album drips with melancholy melodies, and yet hammers with bludgeoning riffs, soars with anthemic sing-a-longs of love-lost and sadness, to bellowing power and undeniable confidence.  

‘UNATØNED’ is Machine Head proving once again that longevity in metal isn’t about comfort – it’s about taking risks, standing firm in conviction, and refusing to stagnate. Eleven albums deep, they remain as fierce, relevant, and unstoppable as ever.

title: muque - Topic
description:
muque(ムク)
Asakura(Vo&Gt)、Kenichi(Gt)、takachi(Track make&Dr) による福岡在住の3ピースバンド。2022年5月結成。 muqueの楽曲はドラマーでありながらトラックメイク/アレンジを手がけるtakachiとトップライン/作詞を担当するAsakuraを中心として制作される。 US、UKに留まらず、ASIANグローバルビート含むワールドワイドな音楽を好むtakachiの同時代性の高いトラック、Asakuraが紡ぐ抒情的な詞世界とどこか和を漂わせるメロディーラインがその最大の魅力。 そんな楽曲がAsakuraによるエモーショナルなヴォーカリゼーションにより独特の世界観を作り出す。 バンド名のmuqueは、フランス語で音楽という意味の「musique」と日本語の「無垢」という言葉をかけたもの。 無垢は穢(けが)れのないという意味で、穢れ のない音楽(muque)=周りに影響されず、自分たちのやりたい音楽を作り続けたい、という思いが込められている。

_______________________

muque is a four-piece band from Fukuoka formed in May 2022, comprising Asakura(Vo&Gt), Kenichi(Gt), Lenon(Ba), and takachi(Track make&Dr). muque’s song is produced mainly by takachi, who is the band’s drummer, trackmaker, and song arranger, and Asakura, who is in charge of the topline and lyricist. Their most appealing features are the contemporaneous tracks by takachi, who prefers not only American and British music, but worldwide music including ASIAN global beats, the poetic lyrics by Asakura, and their melody lines with a Japanese feel. This song creates a unique world through Asakura’s emotional vocalization. The band’s name “muque” combines the French word “musique”, meaning “music,” and the Japanese word “無垢”(muku), which means “purity”. The band’s name expresses the desire to continue producing only the kind of music they want to make, without being influenced by their surroundings.

title: Edson e Hudson
description:
Nascidos e criados em família circense, os irmãos Cadorini tiveram grande apoio do pai, o palhaço e acrobata Beijinho, que percebeu o carisma e o talento dos filhos ainda quando crianças. Incentivados pela família, começaram a cantar em dupla desde muito novos. Inicialmente, utilizavam os pseudônimos de Pepi e Pupi e apresentavam-se em praças públicas, bares, rodeios, bailes e em circos. Acostumados desde cedo aos espetáculos e à estrada, logo adquiriram a experiência necessária para mostrar o potencial que tinham para a música.

Em 1991, já como Edson & Hudson, passaram pelo show de calouros de Raul Gil, onde tiveram a grande oportunidade de serem vistos e ouvidos pelo grande público.A voz poderosa e afinada de Edson unida aos riffs de rock da guitarra de Hudson (a época nada usuais na música sertaneja), chamaram logo a atenção do público e dos formadores de opinião. Essa mistura acabou se tornando o grande diferencial da dupla e marcou um estilo que revolucionou o mercado sertanejo

description:
Marisol (La Faraona de la Cumbia)

Es una cantante peruana de cumbia. Es la vocalista principal de su propia orquesta Marisol y la Magia del Norte.
Conocida como la Faraona de la Cumbia, por ser una de las voces femeninas más representativas de la cumbia norteña.
En 2004, como solista fundó su propia orquesta llamada La Magia del Norte.1​ Fue en el año 2007 que la agrupación logra ingresar con fuerza al mercado musical de Lima a través de sus canciones «30 segundos» y «Si me ibas a dejar» inspirados en situaciones de desamor y cuyo mensaje es motivar a los mujeres que se hagan respetar.
Desde entonces, ella y su orquesta realizaron giras tanto en  Europa como en la comunidad  latinoamericana. La cantante ha sido invitada actuar dentro de los conciertos de personalidades como Tony Rosado Eva Ayllón, Oscar d'León entre otros.

En 2020, ingresó al concurso La máscara, alcanzando el segundo lugar con la personificación de la Mariposa.

title: Marco Flores - Topic
description:
Marco Antonio Flores Sánchez (músico, cantante, director y productor), originario de Jerez, 
Zacatecas tuvo desde casa la influencia musical. A los 8 años, fue motivado por su padre a 
interesarse en el arte de la música, teniendo sus primeras presentaciones a los 10 años en un 
mariachi familiar. Llegó a acompañar a Antonio Aguilar en su Rancho con el mariachi de su 
papá siendo un niño todavía.
Antes de cumplir los 15 años, viaja a la Unión Americana donde le llama la atención la música 
de tamborazo y, con las bases musicales que llevaba de su papá, comienza a tocar en una de 
las mejores bandas de Los Ángeles. Después, tiene la oportunidad de grabar con artistas 
importantes como Chalino Sánchez, Graciela Beltrán, El Gallo de la Sierra. Fue en aquel lugar 
donde conoció a los Cuates Valenzuela, tocando y trabajando juntos hicieron arreglos grabar 
más de 300 discos a diferentes artistas en Estados Unidos.
Cuando regresa a Jerez, tiene la inquietud de hacer una banda pero que sonara y tuviera un 
estilo diferente, quería que fuera más alegre. Fue así que, con sacrificio, pero mucho 
entusiasmo creó una agrupación que vio por primera vez la luz un 15 de septiembre de 1999 
cuando tocaron en las Fiestas Patronales del pueblo en honor a la Virgen de la Soledad.
Jerez, cuna del tamborazo vio entonces cómo había nacido la agrupación que pondría en alto 
su nombre más allá de las fronteras, “La Número 1 Banda Jerez” que más tarde se llamaría 
“Marco Flores y la Jerez”.
